core_obligations: Construct the comparison morphism of topoi and establish the required objectwise cohomology comparison under the stated closure and covering assumptions.
Pass from objectwise comparisons to global cohomology throughCech spectral sequences, handling products of representable sheaves that need not themselves be objects of the subcategory.

proof_roadmap.step: Construct the comparison morphism of topoi and establish the required objectwise cohomology comparison under the stated closure and covering assumptions.
Pass from objectwise comparisons to global cohomology throughCech spectral sequences, handling products of representable sheaves that need not themselves be objects of the subcategory.

difficulty_reason: The global site generally has no final object and theCech terms need not lie in the chosen subcategory. Identifying and comparing those terms is the non-routine part of this H2 comparison theorem.
